name: @forgewallet/protocol-lending-kamino-solana
description: Kamino for @forgewallet/wallet-solana accounts: Kamino Earn vaults (kVaults: deposit / withdraw, shares, APY) and Kamino Lend markets (supply, withdraw, borrow, repay against an obligation) as LendingProtocols. Transactions come from Kamino's official API and are signed only after the wallet's serialized-transaction guard proves the programs and the balance changes; positions, APY and TVL from the same API.
